stage: Initial artifact-reading pass, before frozen summaries/output creation
method: Frozen observation reads each request and receipt once and each response twice. Sum exact bytes from completed immutable artifact inventory. Subtract known startup file reads; bracket startup/import overhead using the early process snapshot. Cross-check a Path.read_bytes read with Windows IO counters. No frozen script or running process was modified.
limitations: Approximate initial reading-stage progress only; not elapsed-time progress or whole-analysis percentage. Bracket assumes substantial unrelated reads have not occurred within the artifact loop. Later statistical computation, provenance reading and output verification remain.
